title: Single Number II
statement_short: Given an integer array nums where every element appears three times except for one, which appears exactly once. Find the single element and implement a solution with linear runtime complexity and O(1) extra space.
constraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 3 \* 10^4, -2^31 <= nums[i] <= 2^31 - 1, every element appears three times except for one
hint: Appears three times constraint with O(1) space requires tracking bit state transitions (ones and twos) mod 3.
keywords: appears three times except for one
why_not: Right: Bit Manipulation tracks 3-state bit counts using bitwise logic (ones and twos bitmasks) in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Frequency counting tracks element occurrences in O(n) time, but uses O(n) auxiliary space violating constraints. Not Sorting: Sorting elements adjacent triplets takes O(n log n) time, violating linear time constraints. Not Math / Geometry: Formula 3\*sum(set) - sum(array) / 2 works, but requires set allocation consuming O(n) space.
